👁️ Eye Pattern: Frosted Irises
Irises with a pale, frosted-over appearance — cold, ice-like, as if crystallized from the edges inward.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Frosted Irises.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply frosted iris patterns with icy crystalline texture or pale cold edges. This is eye appearance only; do not create active ice powers, mist, or aura.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
